$comment: cairn preset: core. The default workflow the renderer uses when a repo's cairn.config.json has no `workflow` block. Each step names its slash command, the underlying fn the agent docs refer to, and the role that runs it. `oneLine` is the AGENTS.md summary; `trackerAction` (optional) is the WORKFLOW.md sync-points cell for a remote tracker.

steps.oneLine: creates the task brief scaffold for you to fill in
steps.trackerAction: create the parent issue if new; always create the child issue for this step (short description, see below); write its key into the brief frontmatter

steps.oneLine: iterative discussion, then writes the enriched description
steps.trackerAction: child issue description ← a short digest of the enriched description, never the file (see below); a 1–2 sentence summary appended to the parent

steps.oneLine: produces the implementation plan and any context-doc updates
steps.trackerAction: parent and child issue → in-progress stage; nothing from the plan is posted

steps.oneLine: implements the plan (switch to Haiku first)
checks the result against the plan and the guidelines
steps.trackerAction: no sync — later stage moves are manual
